author: 吟遊 ノクト

options: 霧に包まれた静寂の浮遊島

en.title: Prometheus of the Silver Resonance: Rusted Melodies and the Sea of Clouds
en.premise: The captain of the airship *Arcadia* encounters a young girl, a "Tuner" capable of repairing machines that have lost their sound. In her hands, she clutches an ancient musical score from a secondhand bookstore, inscribed with a long-lost melody. Together, they embark on a journey through the sea of clouds to unravel the mystery of the "Silent Mist" that threatens to plunge the world into eternal stillness. When the gears mesh and a singing voice shakes the heavens, the fate of the world begins to play once more.

zh.title: 银奏的普罗米修斯 ―锈蚀的旋律与云海航路―
zh.premise: 飞船“阿尔卡迪亚号”的船长，遇见了一位能够修复失去声音的机械的“调律师”少女。她的手中，紧握着一本记载着失落古代旋律的旧书店古乐谱。为了解开将世界推向寂静的“沉默之雾”之谜，两人踏上了穿梭于云海之中的旅程。当齿轮咬合，歌声震颤长空之时，世界的命运将再次奏响。
